example.title: ImageMagick in a tab: sepia on a 480 by 320 PNG, nothing uploaded

shots.alt: magick-webCLI after a sepia run: the input gradient on the left, the sepia-toned output on the right, and the log line 'Done: sepia 80%'.

example.requests: 14 requests during page load and the run: 9 to magick.webcli.app, 3 to cdnjs.cloudflare.com (icon font), 2 to cdn.jsdelivr.net (ImageMagick WebAssembly). All are GETs and none carries a body, so the image is in no request.
example.verify: Open DevTools, Network, then drop an image and press Process.
example.note: magick has no run= surface yet, so this is the interactive path; the cards below say which tools can be driven from a URL today.

tools.name: ffmpeg
tools.role: Media transform: trim, compress, convert, GIF, audio extraction, and raw FFmpeg commands (ffmpeg.wasm).
inputs: video, audio or image file chosen on the device

tools.name: whisper
tools.role: Speech-to-text transcription with Whisper, on the device.
inputs: audio or video file chosen on the device

tools.name: 3mf
tools.role: GLB to 3MF converter with colour-based material segmentation, for multi-material 3D printing.
inputs: GLB file chosen on the device
outputs: GLB with a baked colour map (download)

tools.name: chat
tools.role: Chat with a large language model that runs in the browser (WebLLM, WebGPU).
inputs: text prompt typed on the device; optional PDF
tools.caveat: No run= surface yet; needs WebGPU.

tools.name: magick
tools.role: Image editing and conversion with ImageMagick (magick-wasm): 100+ formats, 26 operations, chaining and batch.
inputs: image file or files chosen on the device
outputs: processed image file (download), or a ZIP for a batch
tools.licence_note: magick-wasm, the engine it wraps, is also Apache-2.0

tools.name: mocap
tools.role: Motion-capture recorder, body, face or both, from a camera or a local video file (MediaPipe).
inputs: camera or video file chosen on the device
tools.caveat: No run= surface yet; the source repository is private.

tools.name: rig
tools.role: Retarget motion onto a character and bake to GLB (body skeleton and face morph targets).
inputs: character: FBX, GLB or VRM URL
motion: BVH or GLB URL, repeatable
outputs: GLB (model/gltf-binary) with the motion baked in

params.name: character
params.description: URL of the character (FBX, GLB, VRM).

params.name: motion
params.description: URL of a BVH or face-record JSON; repeat for several tracks.

params.name: map
params.description: URL of a flat bone-map JSON.

params.name: run
params.description: Start the op as soon as the page loads.

result.shape: { ok, op: 'bake', artifact: { mime, name, size, dataUrl } | null, error: string | null, meta: { tracks, frames, fps, mapped, bones, units, blendshapes } }

tools.caveat: Fetches the input URLs you pass, by GET. The in-page assist is off by default; if you turn it on it loads WebLLM and downloads model weights.

tools.name: portrait
tools.role: Photo to a face-bound VRM: reads a face on the device and binds its expressions (and optionally face and hair shape) to a base VRM.
inputs: photo: a local file only, never a URL (identity data)
vrm: male, female, a URL, or a local file

params.name: vrm
params.description: Base VRM; defaults to the bundled male model.

params.name: run
params.description: Start the bind once a photo is supplied from local disk.

params.name: download
params.description: With run=bind, also save the result.

result.shape: { ok, op: 'bind', artifact: { mime, name, size, dataUrl } | null, error: string | null, meta }

tools.caveat: Expression-bound, photo-informed, not a likeness. The photo is read from a local file only, so a run needs a person or a runner with the file.

tools.name: look
tools.role: VRM look editor: recolour textures, edit materials, dress with outfits and accessories, export the edited VRM.
inputs: vrm: URL or a local file

params.name: vrm
params.description: URL of the VRM to edit.

params.name: run
params.description: Load the VRM and export it without a click.

result.shape: { ok, op: 'export', artifact: { mime, name, size, dataUrl } | null, error: string | null, meta: { source, bytesIn, bytesOut, vrmVersion } }

tools.caveat: Whether look keeps its own front door or merges into portrait is not decided; it is listed separately because it has its own origin.

planned.name: portrait-metahuman
